environment.cpu: Intel Core i9-13900HX (8 performance + 16 efficiency cores, 32 logical CPUs)
environment.configuration: 2D Release, C++23, PCH ON, compiler cache OFF, LTO OFF; other options held constant
environment.source_filesystem: Linux partition, including cached dependency sources
environment.build_affinity: Four workers on CPUs 0,2,4,6 (one thread per performance core)
environment.host_activity: Other user jobs active during parts of the session; thermal/frequency, memory and filesystem effects are not isolated.

implementation.effect: Append private -O1 to the nine C++ sources and matching PCH of kin_scripting_scenes in Release and RelWithDebInfo. Normal -O2 flag remains earlier in Release commands; last optimization flag wins. Other target settings, sources, safety and API macros are unchanged.
rejections_when_applied: CMake CXX compiler ID other than GNU or Clang
implementation.standard_development_presets: Explicitly select OFF; fast presets override ON in separate binary directories.

build_method.scope: Delete only the ten known binding object/PCH outputs, then build hex_demo. Includes fresh target PCH, nine source compilations, one archive and the final game link. All other target objects, dependencies, shaders and game objects prebuilt.
build_method.timer: GNU time around taskset -c 0,2,4,6 cmake --build BUILD --parallel 4 --target hex_demo
build_method.order: Rounds 0 and 2: Clang then GCC, O2 then O1. Round 1: GCC then Clang, O1 then O2. Three pairs per compiler.
build_method.configuration: Untimed CMake configure selects the option before each run. Existing caches preserve compiler and all other settings. A normal Ninja glob check remains inside build wall time.
build_method.memory: GNU time maximum child RSS is not aggregate simultaneous compiler memory.
build_method.instrumentation_note: The first Clang O2 build completed successfully, but the initial collector counted the Ninja glob check as a thirteenth build action. Its original timing/log/archive were retained after fixing the action filter; load-average snapshots for that first run were not retained. No measured build sample was discarded.

clang.only_difference: one additional -O1 in each changed compile command

gcc.only_difference: one additional -O1 in each changed compile command

runtime_method.link: Compile each probe once per compiler with the unchanged test flags (assertions enabled); link against either the complete saved O2 or O1 binding archive. All other engine and Lua libraries, flags and link order are identical. Each link contains exactly one binding archive; substitution verified for both compilers and both probes.
runtime_method.order: Same compiler and O2/O1 order reversal as build rounds. Each mode executes the general and workflow probe. 24 processes in total.
runtime_method.sampling: Three warmups, then 30 raw timed samples per workload in each process; process median computed with statistics.median, then median of three process medians. Raw samples retained in execution order.
runtime_method.compile_and_link: Outside runtime timing; all probes prepared before any runtime measurements. No concurrent benchmark/validation builds during timing.
runtime_method.assertions: Scene and entity final positions, successful protected Lua calls, expected inactive input state, empty/disconnected controller state and returned iteration counts.

runtime_workloads.scene_20000_calls_ms: One scene update with 10000 alive/translate pairs; includes command application.
runtime_workloads.entity_50000_calls_ms: Update 100 scripted entities, each looping 100 times over alive, position, move, rotation and set_rotation.
runtime_workloads.input_400000_calls_ms: 100000 held/pressed/released/axis groups on an inactive context, including Lua loop/assert overhead.
runtime_workloads.tables_40000_calls_ms: 20000 devices/state(1) groups on disconnected controllers, including Lua loop/assert and allocation overhead.

limits: This is a complete binding-target rebuild, not a full Kin/game/dependency/shader build. A game-source edit is not accelerated by this private option.
Small local sample counts on a shared hybrid-core laptop; absolute times and ratios vary by host load, affinity and filesystem. No confidence intervals or universal speedup claimed.

Runtime medians moved in both directions and overlap process-to-process variation. Probe results do not establish real-game frame time, FPS or whole-game runtime performance. Headless games verify correctness only.
The baseline includes the earlier workflow callback optimization (7749e3b). All nine C++ source hashes match that commit.
Only Linux GCC/Clang with 2D Release, PCH and no compiler cache/LTO were measured. No Windows/MSVC, full 3D runtime, LTO or PGO validation in this round.

steps: Create an isolated worktree at base_commit and apply this build-option diff. Use a separate persistent build directory per compiler. Prebuild dependencies, shaders, all non-binding engine objects and hex_demo with the options recorded above.
Adjust the embedded script paths to your worktree/build/output directories and choose a TMPDIR on a volume with adequate free space. Keep compiler and all other build flags fixed.

Run scripting_o1_measure.py. It rebuilds only the nine target objects and matching PCH per run, verifies scope and saves both binding archives from the first pair. Existing result rows allow resuming the collector.

Run scripting_o1_runtime.py to compile/link probes and collect raw timings. Capture O2 Lua API reports as the validation reference (the recorded run reused the already saved four host reports from the preceding round).

Run scripting_o1_validate.py for both compilers. Run scripting_o1_presets.py to configure fresh preset trees with cached dependency sources. Finally run scripting_o1_restore.py to restore normal benchmark build flags, rebuild the selected executables and smoke-test both games.

import hashlib,json,os,pathlib,subprocess
base=pathlib.Path('/mnt/windows/Users/amedeo/Desktop/gamedev');out=base/'kin-scripting-o1-bench';repo=pathlib.Path('/home/bamedeo/kin-wt/build-time');results=[]
pattern='^(kin-(build-config|scripting|entity-scripts|lua-script|lua-workflows2d|lua-runtime|lua-tooling|scene|scene-asset|scene-workflow2d)|hex-demo|shapes-demo)$'
targets=['kin_lua','kin_lua_script_tests','kin_scripting_tests','kin_entity_scripts_tests','kin_lua_workflows2d_tests','kin_lua_runtime_tests','kin_scene_tests','kin_scene_asset_tests','kin_scene_workflow2d_tests','hex_demo','shapes_demo']
for compiler in ['clang','gcc']:
 build=base/('kin-build-time-clang' if compiler=='clang' else 'kin-build-time-out');tmp=base/('kin-scripting-o1-tests-'+compiler);tmp.mkdir(exist_ok=True);env={**os.environ,'TMPDIR':str(tmp),'SDL_VIDEODRIVER':'dummy','SDL_AUDIODRIVER':'dummy','CC':'clang' if compiler=='clang' else 'gcc','CXX':'clang++' if compiler=='clang' else 'g++'}
 with (out/(compiler+'-validation-build.log')).open('w') as log:
  subprocess.run(['cmake','-S','/tmp/kin-build-time','-B',str(build),'-DKIN_DEV_FAST_SCRIPTING=ON'],env=env,stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,check=True)
  subprocess.run(['cmake','--build',str(build),'--parallel','4','--target',*targets],env=env,stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,check=True)
 with (out/(compiler+'-tests.log')).open('w') as log:subprocess.run(['ctest','--test-dir',str(build),'--output-on-failure','-j','2','-R',pattern],env=env,stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,check=True)
 print('Passed 12 selected tests with fast scripting: '+compiler,flush=True)
 reports={}
 for host in ['scene','entity','test','scenario']:
  result=subprocess.run([str(build/'bin/kin_lua'),'api','--host',host],env=env,text=True,capture_output=True,check=True);report=json.loads(result.stdout)
  reference=json.loads((base/'kin-workflow-build-bench'/('api-after-'+compiler)/(host+'.json')).read_text());assert report==reference,(compiler,host);(out/(compiler+'-api-'+host+'.json')).write_text(result.stdout);reports[host]=hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(report,sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':')).encode()).hexdigest()
 row={'compiler':compiler,'mode':'KIN_DEV_FAST_SCRIPTING=ON','selected_tests_passed':12,'test_regex':pattern,'api_matches_o2':reports};results.append(row);(out/'validation-results.json').write_text(json.dumps(results,indent=2)+'\n');print('All API hosts match O2: '+compiler,flush=True)

import json,os,pathlib,shlex,subprocess
base=pathlib.Path('/mnt/windows/Users/amedeo/Desktop/gamedev');out=base/'kin-scripting-o1-bench';env={**os.environ,'TMPDIR':str(base/'kin-scripting-o1-tmp'),'SDL_VIDEODRIVER':'dummy','SDL_AUDIODRIVER':'dummy'};results=[]
targets=['kin_lua','kin_lua_script_tests','kin_scripting_tests','kin_entity_scripts_tests','kin_lua_workflows2d_tests','kin_lua_runtime_tests','kin_scene_tests','kin_scene_asset_tests','kin_scene_workflow2d_tests','hex_demo','shapes_demo']
for compiler in ['clang','gcc']:
 build=base/('kin-build-time-clang' if compiler=='clang' else 'kin-build-time-out')
 with (out/(compiler+'-restore.log')).open('w') as log:
  subprocess.run(['cmake','-S','/tmp/kin-build-time','-B',str(build),'-DKIN_DEV_FAST_SCRIPTING=OFF'],env=env,stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,check=True)
  db=json.loads((build/'compile_commands.json').read_text());baseline=json.loads((out/(compiler+'-command-scope.json')).read_text())['target_commands']['o2']
  for entry in db:
   if entry['file'] in baseline:assert shlex.split(entry['command'])==baseline[entry['file']],entry
  subprocess.run(['cmake','--build',str(build),'--parallel','4','--target',*targets],env=env,stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,check=True)
  subprocess.run(['ctest','--test-dir',str(build),'--output-on-failure','-R','^(hex-demo|shapes-demo)$'],env=env,stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,check=True)
 results.append({'compiler':compiler,'mode':'KIN_DEV_FAST_SCRIPTING=OFF','all_binding_compile_commands_match_o2_baseline':True,'selected_targets_rebuilt':targets,'game_smoke_tests_passed':['hex-demo','shapes-demo']});(out/'restore-results.json').write_text(json.dumps(results,indent=2)+'\n');print('Restored and verified O2: '+compiler,flush=True)
